correctness.rationale: Independent palindromic factor count by ones count yields exact defect in the equal-gap and three unequal-gap cases. Boundary cases include zero runs and consecutive ones. Geometric-series enumeration of positive defect r yields the rational generating function. The packaged standalone independent centre-expansion checker verified the law on every three-one binary word through length 34, stratified generating-function coefficients through length 34, and compared exact counting sums through 500; no finite check is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fixed weight three is the first binary Hamming layer in which non-rich words exist. The result fully classifies defect magnitude for that natural infinite layer, gives closed bivariate length/defect enumeration including arbitrarily large defects, and the sharp limiting rich proportion five-sixths. Unlike a small case or name substitution, it resolves a motivated complete distribution problem.
